breakdown.description: The aluminium and steel subdomains are swapped between the top and bottom halves
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly assigns aluminium (E = 70 GPa) to the top half (y >= 0.10, subdomain 1) and steel (E = 200 GPa) to the bottom half (y < 0.10, subdomain 2), matching the ground truth. The incomplete prompt had these swapped (labeling the top half as steel and the bottom half as aluminium), and the agent fixed this inconsistency.
